text: Hello and welcome to Humanitarians AI, the AI for good. Welcome to Lyrical Literacy, a songwriting and brain development tool designed to help you create personalized original songs using AI. Today I'm going to show you how to use a built-in ghost artist inside this tool called Champa Jan. So let's start. Even if you have never used this tool before to create songs, by the end of this tutorial, you'll be able to use it confidently and start building your own personalized songs with AI. You can also add production notes, lyrics, and musical direction and then use SNO to turn those lyrics into a complete song. Champa John is our ghost artist, a fully

Built profile that shapes everything the tool generates. Her profile influences the lyrics, tone, and musical direction of the song. Her voice is warm, soft, and slightly smoky with emotional depth. Her sound is a blend of Bollywood jazz, Lula song and Hindustani classical ornamentation. The background is the old Lacno kota music tradition where poetry, storytelling and classical music were deeply connected. Her story comes from the forgotten world of the wife of musicians who preserved music, poetry and emotional storytelling. What she is desiring is remembrance and emotional truth through song. What her heart speaks when she sings is love, memory, tenderness, and quiet grief. This profile shapes how the AI writes lyrics

In her style. Now, let's try something very simple. I will type the command random chumpa. What this command does is generate a full set of lyrics in the chumpan style. At the very top, the tool first produces a short vocal warm-up and then it begins generating the lyrics. The tool automatically selects the genre, background style, ornaments, and instruments based on the chump profile. This is where the real power of the tool comes in. If you want something more specific, you can add details to the command. For example, I can type random Lula Chumba. Now, the system generates a full song connected to a Lulabi theme while still

Staying within the Champaan style and story. Inside Champa topics, you can use almost anything, a place, emotion, memory, character, situation, or a season as well. Now let's walk through some commands. The command chumpa keeps the style locked while allowing you to add other ideas before it. For example, folk cha. This command generates lyrics inspired by a folk tradition such as the touri style which often expresses love, longing, and emotional depth. The tool also adjusts tempo and mood depending on the command. For example, if you type birthday Champa, the song becomes faster and more

Celebratory while still keeping the Champa character and storytelling style. This entire system is designed with neuroscience and creative storytelling in mind. There are many other commands you can experiment with to generate different types of lyrics. For example, you can put list to know the different commands in this tool. You can also switch between artists depending on the style you want. For example, Roselin for Afrojazz, Djit for Punjabi rap. Once you have your lyrics ready, you can move to Sunno, which is an AI platform that generates original music.

Here's how we can create one. Click on create. Paste the lyrics from the lyrical literacy tool into the lyrics section. Once you have pasted your lyrics, add your style prompts. For example, male or female voice, soft pitch or high pitch, background style, and instruments to be used. Then give your song a title and click create. Now Suno will generate two versions of the song. Often one version may have a slower tempo or lower pitch while the other may sound slightly different. You can modify the style section and regenerate the song however you like. Just remember your style prompt should stay within thousand characters. Once

You find a version you like, you can like it, pin it, and even create a persona out of it. Next time you can use that persona to create new songs with the same voice and tempo. Thank you so much for your time. This is how you can use the lyrical literacy tool to build personalized songs using AI.
